title: IMP System Change Notification

date.notes: The RFC document header reads 19 April 1972; use the document text as the date authority for this record.

publisher_or_issuer: Network Working Group / RFC Editor archival corpus
redistribution_notes: Prefer the RFC Editor canonical copy and metadata unless repository mirroring is independently useful.

provenance.original_holder: ARPANET Network Working Group / BBN-NET publication stream
provenance.chain_notes: Contemporary BBN-NET field-change notification written while planning IMPSYS 2600.

claims_extracted.claim: On 19 April 1972 RFC 331 describes IMPSYS 2514 as the current system that would be reloaded if the planned experimental IMPSYS 2600 cutover failed.
claims_extracted.notes: This establishes an operational lower bound for IMPSYS 2514 by 19 April 1972, not the exact successful installation time at every ARPANET site.

claims_extracted.claim: RFC 331 planned IMPSYS 2600 field release for 15 May 1972 and required site personnel to load new IMPLOD 2600 tapes, documenting the operational mechanism of network-wide IMP software transition.
claims_extracted.notes: Useful context for how BBN coordinated IMP software releases; it does not prove that the earlier 2514 rollout used identical procedures at every site.

notes: Use this source only as a lower-bound confirmation that 2514 was operational by April 1972; RFC 271's 13 January date is explicitly a schedule.
